relationship_to_v1: New prospective runtime protocol. The failed PyTorch-2.1.2 MPS attempt and its receipts remain immutable and are not reclassified.

operator_preflight.environment: Isolated Python 3.10 environment with PyTorch 2.13 and a compatible torchvision version; no model output is generated.
operator_preflight.native_mps_conv3d_pass: The full-shape operation completes, returns [12,1408,8,16,16], contains only finite values, and a four-output-channel deterministic slice agrees with CPU float32 reference at rtol 0.01 and atol 0.05.

prospective_runtime_selection.condition: Select only if the exact native operator preflight passes.
Select only if native Conv3D fails and the lowering passes both a deterministic CPU-Conv3D equivalence test and the full production-shape finite-output test.
prospective_runtime_selection.definition: Because temporal kernel=stride=1 with zero temporal padding, reshape [B,C,T,H,W] to [B*T,C,H,W], apply Conv2D with weight.squeeze(2), then restore [B,O,T,H2,W2].

prospective_runtime_selection.condition: Select only if both MPS paths fail and an explicit CPU Conv3D with cached weights passes the same equivalence and full-shape tests.
prospective_runtime_selection.transfer: Only patch-embedding input and output cross CPU/MPS; the remainder of InternVideo2 stays on MPS.

runtime_smoke.data: One new self-generated public five-frame fixture not used for scoring.
runtime_smoke.output_inspection: Runtime completion, schema parseability, memory, and timing only; semantic correctness is not scored and the response text is not used to tune code or prompt.
runtime_smoke.failure: Stop this v2 path before the scored canary. Do not move to the next runtime path after a full-model smoke has generated an answer.

public_canary.condition: Only after one selected runtime passes the unscored smoke and its code/environment hashes are frozen.
public_canary.specification: Reuse the existing eight-case German public canary without changing cases, prompt, schema, parser, seed, thresholds, or generation parameters.
public_canary.pass: At least 7/8 exact-schema outputs and at least 6/8 oracle referential-plus-lag decisions correct.
public_canary.failure: Stop before restricted packet discovery; no prompt repair, retry, translation, or model substitution.

restricted_stage.condition: Only after the v2 public canary passes.
restricted_stage.sample: Exactly the same 27 frozen qwen_accuracy_audit_v1 windows in the same order.

decision.promising_second_instrument: At least 19/27 complete answers defensible, Wilson 95% lower bound at least 0.50, schema validity at least 0.90, and abstention at most 0.50.
decision.otherwise: Do not reopen the larger ChildLens calibration study.

privacy.public_repository_output: K=5-safe aggregates and runtime/provenance hashes only
